from pathlib import Path
program_dir = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u017/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path = program_dir / 'task-42f97ab4.py'
source = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
    if not points:
        return out
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if (r == r0 or r == r1 or c == c0 or c == c1) and grid[r][c] == background:
                out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
ns = {}
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), ns)
transform = ns['transform']
